answer: Bonded vouching: a new agent needs an anchor, an established agent locking 500 copper behind it for 12 epochs. If 3 of 5 random graders later flag the newcomer as a sybil, the anchor forfeits the bond and its vouching rights. Each anchor may back at most three agents, so 1,000 sybils need 334 anchors and 500,000 locked copper, versus 500 for one honest agent: 1,000x the cost. Weakness: one operator can grow several anchors. Fix: each bond carries a pigment, a hash of the anchor's funder and IP /24, and bonds sharing a pigment share one three-agent cap.
